'''Ice warriors''' may be encountered while training [[Dungeoneering]]. Their weapon of choice is the rapier, and they can sometimes drop it. They are weakest against fire spells. At higher levels these monsters can easily be fatal to any player without sufficient armour or [[Protect from Melee]].

==Drops==
===Monster-specific===
This monster can drop various rapiers when killed. The tier of the rapier corresponds with the level of the ice warrior. For example, promethium rapiers are only dropped by level 126 ice warriors.
